site: Example Crazyflie trajectory bench (operator overlay example, not a flight approval)
notes: Example numeric envelopes only. The pinned clone states no numeric operating bound for any of these inputs, so these values are operator choices, not device facts, not a flight envelope and not a recommendation. A real site must replace them with its own assessed limits.

data[*].reason: example site envelope for one spline coefficient

time.reason: example site envelope for one trajectory packet duration

index.reason: example site envelope for a spline index

dimension.reason: example site envelope for the flat-output dimension selector

number.reason: example site envelope for a spline count

type.reason: example site envelope for a spline type selector

synchronize.reason: example site envelope for the synchronization flag

circular[*].reason: example site envelope for a circular flag

number[*].reason: example site envelope for a spline count

time[*].reason: example site envelope for the replicated start delay

linear.x.reason: example site envelope for Twist linear.x (meaning set by the external driver)

linear.y.reason: example site envelope for Twist linear.y (meaning set by the external driver)

linear.z.reason: example site envelope for Twist linear.z (meaning set by the external driver)

angular.x.reason: example site envelope for Twist angular.x (meaning set by the external driver)

angular.y.reason: example site envelope for Twist angular.y (meaning set by the external driver)

angular.z.reason: example site envelope for Twist angular.z (meaning set by the external driver)
